source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Checkbox changes serialize selected servers while leaving the visible row in place. Reset clears the user preference and rebuilds. The browser task separately checks added-server count, checked input and label text, then default preference state and removal of the extra row after reset. Its initial child count includes a retained template, so children length is not always a server count. No test was executed here, and the primary bug discussion is incomplete.
title: Keyserver tests check serialized preference state and concrete DOM output separately
